part.text:
The fix is a one-line change in the child normalization logic of the diff renderer.

## Root cause

When rendering `{5n}`, `diffChildren` normalizes each child in `normalizeChildAt` (src/diff/children.js:168). The predicate `isTextLikeChild` (src/diff/children.js:193) only recognized `string` and `number`, so a `bigint` child fell through to `adoptExistingChild()` — i.e., it was treated as an already-created vnode. Later, `attachChildParent()` (src/diff/children.js:251) tried `childVNode._parent = newParentVNode` on the primitive `5n`, producing the minified-name error `can't assign to property "__" on 5n: not an object` (`_parent` mangles to `__` per mangle.json).

## Fix

`src/diff/children.js` — `isTextLikeChild` now also accepts `bigint`, so bigint children get wrapped into a proper text vnode. Text-node diffing already handles it: `document.createTextNode(newProps)` and `dom.data = newProps` coerce `5n` to `"5"`.

## Validation (in the container)

- Baseline (`git stash`): `✖ should render bigint as text content` failed, plus one pre-existing flaky failure (`should use capturing for event props ending with *Capture`, headless-Chrome focus event).
- With the fix: full Karma browser suite runs 944 tests — the bigint render test passes; only the pre-existing focus failure remains (identical to baseline).
- `npx mocha --recursive --require "@babel/register" test/shared test/node`: 29 passing.
